  Repeat.

  Resolve the Dúnedain Rangers trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, and causing the creature token to become your Ring-bearer.
  Sméagol triggers.
  Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
  Resolve the Sméagol trigger, causing an opponent to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then causing you to put the land onto the battlefield tapped under your control, and your opponent to put all other revealed cards into their graveyard.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: This combo can be stopped if an opponent runs out of lands in their library, so it is recommended to alternate opponents in between cycles to maximize the amount of iterations.

Color identity: BG | Bracket: 2-3+ (Oddball) | Popularity: 12 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite +1/+1 counters on a creature; Infinite death triggers; Infinite landfall triggers; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Put all lands with a basic land type from your library into your hand
Start: Yedora, Grave Gardener (battlefield); Nervous Gardener (battlefield); Carrion Feeder (battlefield)
Steps: Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Nervous Gardener.
  When Nervous Gardener dies, Yedora triggers, returning Nervous Gardener from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
  Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
  Activate Nervous Gardener by tapping it, adding {G}.
  Activate Nervous Gardener's disguise ability by paying {G}, turning it face-up.
  Nervous Gardener triggers, causing you to search your library for a land with a basic land type and put it into your hand.
  Repeat.

  Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
  Repeat.
